history.new: For every set of laws, if anchored models of coprime sizes N and M exist, then an anchored model of size NM exists (transport the direct product along the Chinese remainder isomorphism, which maps x + 1 to (x + 1, x + 1)). In particular no anchored spectrum (which always contains 1) has the form {1} together with a set of primes containing two primes but not their product - for example {1} together with an infinite set of primes.
